entries.0726057a3b8048c1: Manufacture and sale of precast concrete products for buildings, and installation work. Produced at the Tsukuba Plant in Shimotsuma, Ibaraki Prefecture. Revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥1,502 million.
entries.078bca2a8dd833ef: Steel demand across the industry has remained at a low level, below 4,000,000 tons, for 2 consecutive years. Demand for large projects, centered on the Tokyo metropolitan area, is firm, but it is affected by persistently high material prices and labor shortages.
entries.1cdb6edc5bd946bb: It owns plants from the Kanto region to western Japan: the Chiba Daiichi Plant and Chiba Daisan Plant in Kashiwa, Chiba Prefecture, the Tsukuba Plant in Shimotsuma, Ibaraki Prefecture, the Osaka Plant in Habikino, Osaka Prefecture, the Okayama Plant in Kasaoka, Okayama Prefecture, and the Yamaguchi Plant in Kudamatsu, Yamaguchi Prefecture, while design and estimating are handled by its subsidiary Kawagishi Planning Co., Ltd. It can carry out everything from design through fabrication to on-site construction within its own group.
entries.277820b4863b7697: It sets "Supporting Japan with steel frames" as its management philosophy (vision), and in the "1st Medium-Term Management Plan (fiscal year ending September 2024 to fiscal year ending September 2026)" defines its target as "a top company supporting Japan with building steel frames 100 years from now." As priority issues, it plans to work on growth and stronger profitability of its core business (sales-driven project management, review and reorganization of production sites, promotion of ICT&DX), stronger financial and capital strategy, co-creation and coexistence with stakeholders, and stronger management foundations.
